snowtracks.screen.title: Snow Tracks Settings
snowtracks.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, no prints are made and any that exist disappear.
snowtracks.option.lifetime.tooltip: How many seconds a footprint in snow lasts before it has filled in. Fresh snowfall wipes prints about four times faster. Mud keeps its prints longer and powder snow loses them sooner.
snowtracks.option.darkness.tooltip: How strongly prints show against the ground. Lower is subtler.
snowtracks.option.other_players.tooltip: Show the footprints of other players, and the grooves they leave when they pull something on a lead.
snowtracks.option.mobs.tooltip: Show paws, hooves, bird feet and rabbit hops from animals.
snowtracks.option.max_prints.tooltip: The most prints shown at once. When it is reached the oldest disappear first, and animals give way before people. Lower it if the game slows down.
